profile.headline: DevOps Software Engineer at Broadcom
profile.summary: DevOps/SCM, Embedded Linux, WiFi, Android Device Driver, Wireless Router

positions.title: Principal DevOps Software Engineer
positions.description:
DevOps/SCM Engineer in Broadcom WiFi team
 - Led the migration of legacy in-house SVN-based CI workflows to GitHub Actions, consolidating multiple separated processes into a unified, maintainable framework.
 - Improved the CI configuration file structure, integrating multiple distributed configs into a centralized GitHub Actions–based system.
 - Designed and integrated API servers to enable seamless communication across internal systems.
 - Maintained and enhanced legacy in-house infrastructure to ensure system stability.

positions.title: DevOps Software Engineer
positions.description:
DevOps Software Engineer at Amazon Web Services (Annapruna Lab)
 - ML CI/CD pipeline setup in AWS cloud (CodePipeline / Cloudformation / Lambda / Python)
 - ML test environment setup and add ML test cases into CI test cases (FSDP, Megatron-GPT3)
 - Show Test progress/results with OpenSearch(Kibana) Dashboard

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
DevOps/SCM Engineer in Broadcom WiFi team

SVN to Git transition support
 - Zuul CI/CD tool evaluation with Git/Gerrit environment
 - Gerrit - Email template customization / UI customization / plugin development

Small projects
 - Release process enhancement/automation for Apple customer release
 - Random commit code audit process - Design/Implementation
 - Elasticsearch/Kibana based Dashboard

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
WiFi - Samsung mobile phone support
 - WiFi Device Driver Porting, Issue support
 - Galaxy S2 ~ S8 / Note series development & issue support
 - RTOS phone platform development & issue support
Software development process Enhancement (DevOps)
 - Setup automating software build processes with Buildbot(from scratch)
 - Create SVN check-in tracking / browsing UI Web (SVN Tracker UI)
 - Create automating software release note / release package system
 - Create Device managing system / SDK list managing system with UI
 - Create SDK extract and build script for android kernel build

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- WiFi Router Project / NAS Project / Security Camera Project
 - Samsung Feature Phone / Samsung Android Phone issue support
 - Linux driver porting

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Wireless Router Development
 - Anygate Wireless Router development
 - Wireless Router for LG VOIP phone
